details:
Public Worlds were anyone can see them and join them but the host would have powers like if it was a Friends or friends plus worlds

This means they could kick players in world if they needed as well as mute and all the other things that come with normal Freinds/plus worlds in a public

the world would be listed in the game list as normal publics and not have anything else diffrent other then this for for more control.

few good cases this could be used is if the host need to remove someone that being toxic but noone will votekick for one reason or another, if the host is say streaming and want to in a public to meet new people but not risk there channel, as well as for removing hackers when vote kicking get blocked, plus many ways im sure im not thinking of.

Edit: Should make it clear this world type be diffrent and smarter then Group Public, reason being as anyone could use it without a group and it wouldn't require somone trusted from a group to be there to work. Instead Idea is have so if the host leaves the next one that joined takes over or better yet a person set in menu would.
title: Public Plus
